note: The verifier's pins for TEE-scored runs. The scorer is tee/ built with tee/build.sh (pinned toolchain, Cargo.lock, remapped paths); rebuilding from this repository must give wasm_sha256. OutLayer endpoints are for testnet.

scorer.reproducibility: tee/build.sh reproduces this sha256 on macOS arm64 with Rust 1.95.0, including from a fresh clone at another path. A Linux x86_64 build of the same commit gave 3266d4393ce7fe07486636a18ca667e7bbae98673191869e0051eef4283753d9 (2026-11-05): builds are not yet identical across platforms.
